user.title: Hathway Broadband
user.description:
Sign in the way the Hathway app does: with your registered mobile number and an SMS OTP.

Hathway allows one active session per account. Signing in here signs the Hathway app out, and signing in on the app later ends this session (Home Assistant will then ask you to sign in again).

menu_options.otp: Sign in with an SMS OTP

otp.title: Registered mobile number
otp.description: Hathway sends a 6-digit OTP to this number.

token.title: Existing session token
token.description: For moving an existing setup (for example a command-line script) without a new SMS. The token, registered mobile number and account number must belong together.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Hathway again
reauth_confirm.description: Hathway ended this session, usually because someone signed in on the Hathway app. Submit to send a new OTP to {mobile}.

error.no_account: Hathway has no broadband account for this mobile number.
error.invalid_otp: Hathway rejected the OTP. Check it and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Hathway. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This Hathway account is already set up; its session was updated.
abort.wrong_account: That OTP signed in to a different Hathway account.

init.title: Billing cycle
init.description: Hathway resets the data quota on the same day every month. Days until reset, the cycle dates and the projection use this day.

data_description.reset_day: For short months a later day falls on the month's last day.
data_description.scan_minutes: How often to ask Hathway for the counter.
